title: Tapered bored adapter
prompt:
All dimensions are millimetres. Build exactly what is described — no fillets, chamfers, draft or extra features unless the description asks for them. Leave the finished part in the document; do not export anything.

A tapered adapter on the Z axis, from Z=0 to Z=30:
- the outside is a straight taper, 40 diameter at Z=0 falling to 24 diameter at Z=30 — one continuous conical surface from end to end, not a series of steps;
- a 12 diameter bore runs all the way through, on the Z axis.
The part is one solid, centred on the Z axis.

checks.why: a true frustum, not a staircase that averages the same envelope
the bore, and it reads as a hole rather than a boss
a taper is bottom-heavy; a straight tube would sit at 15
the taper is a real cone — revolve and loft both give one, a stack of discs gives none
two annular ends; a stepped approximation adds a plane per step
